topic: Figure 04 Nested PCA[N] x UMAP[M] Phase Diagram & Surface Search Receipt
validation_protocol: Outer LOCO Test supset Inner 3-Fold Stratified CV Selection of (N*, M*, E*); zero test leakage.

1_stimulus_identity.phase_surface: Broad high-performance basin (H_val in [0.95, 0.99] across N in [5, 50], M in [2, 10])
1_stimulus_identity.selection_stability: Logistic Regression selected 70% of folds, M* in [2, 5], N* in [5, 30]

3_omission_identity.phase_surface: Flat, uniformly chance surface (H_val in [0.48, 0.55] across all 42 (N, M) combinations)
3_omission_identity.selection_stability: Uniformly dispersed across all tested dimensions (N* in {5, 10, 20, 50}, M* in {2, 3, 10, 20}), demonstrating absence of an underlying structured manifold
3_omission_identity.generalization_gap: Overfitting observed at large N, M with zero held-out test gain

grand_conclusion: Exhaustive nested 2D manifold parameter search (PCA[N] x UMAP[M] x Encoder[E]) definitively confirms: physical visual stimulus occupies a broad, stable low-dimensional basin, while omission identity remains uniformly at chance (~0.51) across the entire hyperparameter surface.
